#: click on a column heading to sort on it 

 Nome                                      Nulo?    Tipo
 ----------------------------------------- -------- ----------------------------
 INST_ID                                            NUMBER
 SADDR                                              RAW(8)
 SID                                                NUMBER
 USER_NAME                                          VARCHAR2(128)
 ADDRESS                                            RAW(8)
 HASH_VALUE                                         NUMBER
 SQL_ID                                             VARCHAR2(13)
 SQL_TEXT                                           VARCHAR2(60)
 LAST_SQL_ACTIVE_TIME                               DATE
 SQL_EXEC_ID                                        NUMBER
 CURSOR_TYPE                                        VARCHAR2(64)
 CHILD_ADDRESS                                      RAW(8)
 CON_ID                                             NUMBER

WITH x AS (
SELECT /*+  NO_MERGE  */ /* 2a.146 */
       COUNT(*) cached_cursors,
	   con_id,
	   inst_id, sid, user_name
  FROM gv$open_cursor
 GROUP BY
       con_id,
       inst_id, sid, user_name
)
SELECT x.*
       ,c.name con_name
  FROM x
       LEFT OUTER JOIN v$containers c ON c.con_id = x.con_id
 ORDER BY
       1 DESC, 2, 3, 4;
